name: ATECH
recent: Aurelius Technologies 公布 2026 财年第三季度净利按年下滑 24.0% 至 1220 万令吉，并宣布每股 0.55 仙的第三次中期股息。公司同时完成员工股份计划下 31,000 股普通股的发行，该批股份于 2026 年 11 月 30 日上市。此外，雇员公积金局在 9 月至 10 月期间多次申报股权变动。
notable: 宣布第三次中期股息每股 0.55 仙，除息日为 2026 年 12 月 10 日，派发日为 2026 年 12 月 23 日。
根据员工股份计划发行 31,000 股普通股，发行价为每股 0.5266 令吉，并于 2026 年 11 月 30 日上市。
公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，净利为 1220 万令吉。
risks: 执行董事兼集团首席财务官 Tan Chong Hin 在闭市期间进行交易，涉及 327,900 股普通股，交易性质为以股代息。
Tan Chong Hin 于 2026 年 11 月 10 日表示有意在闭市期间进行交易。
雇员公积金局在 2026 年 9 月至 10 月期间多次申报股权变动。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 1.4146 亿令吉，按季增长 8.5%，按年下降 13.2%；净利为 1126 万令吉，按季增长 22.7%，按年下降 31.2%；净利率为 8.0%，高于上一季度的 7.0%。

recent_en: Aurelius Technologies reported a 24.0% year-on-year decline in Q3 FY2026 net profit to RM12.2 million and declared a third interim dividend of 0.55 sen per share. The company also completed the issuance of 31,000 ordinary shares under its Employees' Share Scheme, listed on 30 November 2026. In addition, the Employees Provident Fund Board made multiple shareholding change filings between September and October.
notable_en: Declared a third interim dividend of 0.55 sen per share, with ex-date on 10 December 2026 and payment date on 23 December 2026.
Issued 31,000 ordinary shares under the Employees' Share Scheme at an issue price of RM0.5266 per share, listed on 30 November 2026.
Announced Q3 FY2026 results with net profit of RM12.2 million.
risks_en: Executive Director and Group Chief Financial Officer Tan Chong Hin dealt in 327,900 ordinary shares during the closed period, with the transaction being a dividend in specie.
Tan Chong Hin indicated on 10 November 2026 an intention to deal during the closed period.
The Employees Provident Fund Board made multiple shareholding change filings between September and October 2026.
earnings_en: For Q3 FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM141.46 million, up 8.5% quarter-on-quarter but down 13.2% year-on-year; net profit was RM11.26 million, up 22.7% quarter-on-quarter but down 31.2% year-on-year; net margin was 8.0%, higher than 7.0% in the previous quarter.
